verdict.rationale: Consensus offers Deep Search, described as more comprehensive literature reviews across many studies that take minutes, plus a research agent that chains search tools. That covers the 'long research job' part of the story only. Nothing in the evidence shows the job running unattended in the background or notifying the user when results are ready. Missing for 10: evidence of background/unattended execution, completion notifications (email/push), job status tracking, independent or hands-on corroboration.
